events.description: Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay currently knows there is a severed thumb in the soda can she opened.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay opened a soda can, discovered a severed thumb inside, and saw the thumb floating in the soda.
Chandler Bing says the severed-thumb-in-the-soda incident might be a contest.
Chandler Bing says everyone knows the kind of contest Chandler Bing is talking about.
Chandler Bing says everyone should collect all five fingers as part of that supposed contest.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is offering to show the severed thumb to anyone who wants to see it right now.
#ALL# says Chandler Bing should not smoke right now.
#ALL# says Chandler Bing should cut it out and stop smoking.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing's smoking is worse than the severed thumb found in the soda can.
Chandler Bing says the group's criticism of Chandler Bing's smoking is unfair.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking why Chandler Bing thinks the group's objection to Chandler Bing's smoking is unfair.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing has a flaw, namely Chandler Bing's smoking.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani's constant knuckle-cracking is also annoying.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller over-pronounces every single word.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller snorts when Monica Geller laughs.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing questions what Monica Geller's snorting laugh even is.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing accepts Joey Tribbiani's knuckle-cracking, Ross Geller's over-pronunciation, and Monica Geller's snorting laugh.
Chandler Bing says everyone should accept Chandler Bing despite Chandler Bing's smoking.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is asking whether Joey Tribbiani's knuckle-cracking bothers everybody right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green could live without Joey Tribbiani's knuckle-cracking.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is asking whether Joey Tribbiani's knuckle-cracking is only a little annoying or as bad as Phoebe Buffay chewing her hair.
Joey Tribbiani says Phoebe Buffay chews her hair.
Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay should not listen to Joey Tribbiani.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller thinks Joey Tribbiani's knuckle-cracking is endearing.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is challenging Ross Geller's claim that Joey Tribbiani's knuckle-cracking is endearing.
Ross Geller says there is nothing wrong with Ross Geller speaking correctly.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green agrees that there is nothing wrong with speaking correctly.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green should get back to work now.
Phoebe Buffay says a customer might actually receive the order the customer asked for, implying Rachel Green often gives the wrong orders at work.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is taking her hair down right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is putting on gloves right now to get ready for a confrontation.
